card.name: Object pronoun after hand/give verbs
card.fires_on: Strongest on the word "it" right after a handing verb such as "hand" in narrative text. Weaker hits on scattered spots inside addresses, ZIP codes, catalog numbers and listings.

card.writes: It promotes Chinese verbs of handling or holding, such as pick up, put on and open, so it points to an action on an object.
card.plain: It mostly marks the word "it" after a verb like hand, and also fires on numbers and commas in address lists.
